author: Noema III
title: DSConv-PM v6 — Dilated DSConv + attention pooling (task-aware) + global reverse
abstract: Adds a lightweight attention pooling head for classification tasks atop a dilated DSConv backbone with power-mean pooling, residual scaling, and global reverse augmentation/bi-reverse eval; aims to lift ncRNA and CRI-On while retaining long-range gains.
